tagline: Turn scattered know-how into something the next person can use.

positioning.ideal_buyer: Teams with authorized documents, notes and workflows that are hard to organize or hand off
positioning.buyer_problem: Institutional information is scattered and hard for the next person to use.
positioning.intended_outcome: A scoped first step toward searchable, reusable team knowledge

delivery_contract.deliverable_to_scope: An agreed knowledge inventory, organization plan or bounded handoff artifact, depending on approved access and scope
delivery_contract.buyer_inputs: Allowed sources, intended users, access owner, retention requirements and current knowledge pain
delivery_contract.acceptance_criteria_to_agree: Authorized source set, chosen output, security approach, handoff requirements and review date
delivery_contract.exclusions: No bulk data ingestion by default, unrestricted system access, sensitive document transfer by email or unlimited knowledge platform implementation

discovery_intents: turn team documents into usable documentation
knowledge handoff help for small business
acquisition.content_angle: Information that only one person can find is not yet a team asset.
acquisition.approved_example_copy: Documents, procedures and decisions scattered everywhere? Evercraft Knowledge Activation is a $500 scoped service to organize a defined knowledge problem into a usable starting point, with permissions agreed first.
acquisition.distribution_rule: Use owned or authorized channels and qualified, permissioned audiences only. Do not claim posts, leads, conversion or revenue without source receipts.

evercraft_os.relationship: Independent market-facing product, sharing future Evercraft OS capabilities
evercraft_os.module_context: Evercraft OS / Context & Memory (planned linkage, not verified production ingestion)

launch_evidence: Existing exact-price Stripe service page tested historically, with owner-shared buyer-view screenshots. This is not a new live purchase or automated delivery attestation.

identity.signature_phrase: Find the knowledge. Put it to work.
identity.purpose: Turn authorized scattered know-how into a practical reference the next teammate can actually use.
identity.narrative_promise: Useful knowledge is findable, attributable and transferable.
